Kangdae, I like it." I confessed with courage to my colleague, who has been in unrequited love for three years. I thought a happy campus couple life was finally beginning for me, but suddenly he pops into the army! "Huh?! This was rejected, wasn't it?" Grand senior Kang Tae-yang, who is like a feud, approaches Sarang, who is upset by the pain of a broken heart. And an amazing word I heard from him. "You confessed to me." I'm going to be upset because I'm in a broken heart with a rhythm. What the hell are you talking about?! Can Sarang, who has a dream of spending his college life with a thrilling campus couple, achieve that dream?
